material_changes.title: PwnSec CTF 2026 has a replacement date and an explicit agent-enabled Cyborg lane
verified_facts: The organizer schedules PwnSec CTF 2026 for September 12, 2026 at 14:00 UTC through September 13, 2026 at 14:00 UTC.
Registration is open and entry is free.
Teams may have up to four participants; solo players may request matching.
The event is a 24-hour Jeopardy CTF with Web, Crypto, Reverse, Pwn, Cloud, Forensics, Mobile and Misc categories.
The organizer runs separate Human and Cyborg leaderboards.
Cyborg teams may use AI, including scripts, agents and autonomous pipelines; Human teams have materially stricter AI restrictions.
The organizer rules say to attack the challenges, not the infrastructure, and prohibit flag sharing outside the team and scoreboard games.
CTFtime currently lists prizes as TBD; no monetary payout is asserted.
missing_verification: Preserve the registered team's faction/participation confirmation before event start.
Re-open the organizer rules immediately before hands-on participation in case the AI policy, team rules or infrastructure boundaries change.
Do not claim any prize value unless the organizer publishes current prize terms.
material_changes.recommended_action: Build/Case agent should treat the Cyborg lane as the authorized agent-assisted competition path, register or confirm a team under the published rules, preserve the final rules at event start, and use only challenge-provided infrastructure during the Sep. 12-13 window.
